prs.tagLine: A place for U to call home

description:
U by Urbeo proudly presents U Clonsilla, a residential development ideally located in Clonsilla, Dublin 15. This exciting development offers a range of beautifully designed Studio, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, finished to a high standard throughout.

Key Features:

- A-rated energy-efficient apartments for year-round comfort
- Stylish interiors designed by Ventura Design
- Spacious layouts with ample storage in all unit types
- Fully fitted kitchens with integrated appliances
- Parking available including EV charge points
- Dedicated on-site management team
- Residents’ lounge & multi-function room
- Additional storage facilities available

Location Highlights:

- Short distance to Blanchardstown Shopping Centre
- Excellent selection of shops, restaurants, cafés & bars nearby
- Close to schools, crèches & colleges
- Wide range of local sports clubs & leisure facilities
- Easy access to M50 motorway
- Approx. 20 minutes to Dublin Airport & Dublin City Centre
- Coolmine Train Station within walking distance
- Well serviced by rail and intercity bus routes

***Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search.***
